2048 by Gabriele Cirulli

The original game_manager.js, grid.js and tile.js are retained here for provenance.
They are not loaded by the local app. ../../tiles-engine.js adapts traversal,
farthest-cell movement and once-per-turn merging into a pure immutable engine.
The local adaptation adds seeded randomness and reversible moves, and replaces
mandatory swipe input with explicit commands supplied by the app.
